description: In-tree reproduction of the memory_recall output-cap size reduction on a synthetic fixture graph (no DB/daemon) -- NOT a reproduction of issue #186's live 93.7 KB audit number, which needs the live daemon and bank it was measured against and cannot be regenerated here.

fixture.note: root has 20 direct (hop-1) children by construction -- wider than the edges cap alone, so a naive flat edges[:N] would be entirely consumed by hop 1.
